changelog: - **Mentee interaction subjects** (#1421). Interaction subjects are now visible to mentees in their full interaction history and as the primary, truncation-safe line in recent journey interactions; entries without a subject retain their existing notes-only presentation.

en: Mentees can now see interaction subjects in their interaction history and recent journey activity.
tr: Mentee'ler artık etkileşim geçmişinde ve yolculuktaki son etkinliklerde etkileşim başlıklarını görebilir.
de: Mentees sehen jetzt die Betreffzeilen von Interaktionen im Verlauf und in den neuesten Aktivitäten ihrer Journey.
